mapper.sql: id, loan_apply_id, request_id, apply_id, mobile_no, credit_application_id, quote_id, profile_id, profile_version_id, external_loan_apply_no, lender_user_id, bill_no, status, external_status, apply_amt, pay_amount, pay_time, last_lender_request_json, last_lender_response_json
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loan_application WHERE loan_apply_id = #{loanApplyId} AND profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_application ( loan_apply_id, request_id, apply_id, mobile_no, credit_application_id, quote_id, profile_id, profile_version_id, status, apply_amt, loan_purpose, submitted_at ) VALUES ( #{loanApplyId}, #{requestId}, #{applyId}, #{mobileNo}, #{creditApplicationId}, #{quoteId}, #{profileId}, #{profileVersionId}, #{status}, #{applyAmt}, #{loanPurpose}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM loan_application WHERE loan_apply_id = #{loanApplyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_application SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('INIT', 'SUBMITTING') THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE status END, external_loan_apply_no = #{externalLoanApplyNo}, external_status = #{externalStatus}, submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE loan_application SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('INIT', 'SUBMITTING') THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE status END, external_loan_apply_no = #{externalLoanApplyNo}, lender_user_id = #{lenderUserId}, external_status = #{externalStatus}, last_lender_request_json = #{lastLenderRequestJson}, last_lender_response_json = #{lastLenderResponseJson}, submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE loan_application SET bill_no = #{billNo}, apply_amt = COALESCE(#{applyAmt}, apply_amt), pay_amount = #{payAmount}, pay_time = #{payTime, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE loan_application SET next_poll_at = #{nextPollAt, typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM loan_application WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND next_poll_at IS NOT NULL AND next_poll_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY next_poll_at LIMIT #{limit}
